# 36Seas Publishing

> 36Seas is an independent publishing company and author studio platform. It publishes books and supports authors through First Mate, its author workspace, publishing resources, and educational webinars.

## Public entry points

- [Books and catalog](https://36seas.com/#catalog): Discover published books and follow links to individual book pages.
- [Author studio overview](https://36seas.com/#first-mate): Learn about First Mate, the author studio platform. The signed-in workspace is private.
- [Become an author](https://36seas.com/become-an-author/): Explore the publishing path and author opportunities.
- [Webinars](https://36seas.com/webinars/): Find educational sessions for authors.
- [Pricing](https://36seas.com/pricing/): Review public plans and publishing service pricing.
- [Company](https://36seas.com/company/): Learn about 36Seas Publishing.

## Discovery and access

- [Sitemap](https://36seas.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages.
- [Crawler policy](https://36seas.com/robots.txt): Search discovery and training crawler directives.

Only public marketing and published book pages are intended for discovery and citation. Author accounts, manuscripts, dashboards, editors, settings, APIs, and staff administration are private. This file describes public content; it does not grant training rights or access to private content.
